title: Enhanced early chronic kidney disease prediction using hybrid waterwheel plant algorithm for deep neural network optimization.
summary: An optimized neural predictor trained on 400 UCI chronic-kidney-disease records was compared with regression and optimization baselines. The retrospective dataset result does not establish prospective clinical utility.
ai_technology: A deep neural network optimized with the hybrid waterwheel-plant algorithm predicts chronic kidney disease from clinical records.
organization: Department of Computer Sciences, College of Computer and Information Sciences, Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University, P.O. Box 84428, Riyadh, 11671, Saudi Arabia

evidence.tested: Retrospective evaluation on 400 UCI records against regression and optimization baselines; prospective clinical utility was not tested.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study
evidence.ai_role: A deep neural network optimized with the hybrid waterwheel-plant algorithm predicts chronic kidney disease from clinical records.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
